title: Build-output naming must stay in sync with server (preload manifest, hashing, publicPath)
answers: What must stay in sync between esbuild output and Django?
Why does the build throw 'preload-manifest.json field resolved empty'?
What breaks if I change hash format or entry names?
body:
- `writePreloadManifest` (frontend/build.mjs) writes dist/preload-manifest.json keys `css`,`font`,`js`,`authenticatedJs`; `_read_preload_manifest` (posthog/utils.py) reads exactly these. Change both together.
- It finds entries by source path: src/index.tsx, src/scenes/App.tsx, src/scenes/AuthenticatedShell.tsx (src/sharedChunkAnchors.ts also an entry); CSS regex `/\/index(-[^./-]+)?\.css$/`, font `/\/Inter(-[^./-]+)?\.woff2$/`. Renames that empty a field make the build throw deliberately. Only chunks >50KB (`PRELOAD_MIN_CHUNK_BYTES`) get preloads.
- URLs are `static/<rel to dist>` prefixed by JS_URL: requires `STATIC_URL='/static/'` and `publicPath:'/static'` in `commonConfig` (common/esbuilder/utils.mjs).
- Names: entryNames `[dir]/[name]-[hash]` prod / unhashed dev; chunkNames `[name]-[hash]`; assetNames `assets/[name]-[hash]`. `createHashlessEntrypoints` regex `/-([A-Z0-9]+).(js|css)$/` makes unhashed fallback used by `copyIndexHtml`; `chunkMapFileName` in common/esbuilder/chunkLoader.mjs writes `chunk-map-<entry>-<HASH8>.js`.
- `copyIndexHtml` injects `<script nonce="{{ request.csp_nonce }}">` → CSPMiddleware must set it.
- `isDev`=`--dev` argv: no hashes/manifest; Python mirrors via DEBUG. Manifest is process-cached, so dist must not change under a running server.
